integrity: A uniform integral homotopy proof is supplied by a complete clique classification and a homotopy pushout; exact binary homology checks on four finite dimensions are corroboration only. Prior work on a long-root-only subconfiguration is not claimed as new or independently recertified.
scientific_limitations: Only the unrescaled Euclidean type-B root configuration with integer dimension at least three is treated, and only radii strictly below sqrt(3). No complete persistence barcode, symmetry character, or normalized-root analogue is asserted.
title: Mixed-dimensional Euclidean Rips homotopy of the type-\(B_n\) root systems
